title: Minimize Deviation in Array
summary: Given an array nums of n positive integers, you can perform the following operations on any element any number of times: - If the element is even, divide it by 2.
statement: Given an array nums of n positive integers, you can perform the following operations on any element any number of times: - If the element is even, divide it by 2. - If the element is odd, multiply it by 2. The deviation of the array is defined as the maximum difference between any two elements in the array. Your task is to find the minimum possible deviation that can be achieved by applying the allowed operations.
constraints: nums contains 2 through 50000 positive integers at most 10^9.
An even value may be halved; an odd value may be doubled. Apply operations any number of times.
Minimize maximum value minus minimum value.
hints: Normalize every number to its greatest reachable even value.
Track the current maximum in a max-heap and the current minimum separately.
Measure the range, then repeatedly halve the maximum while it is even, updating the minimum.
Only decreasing the current maximum can improve the range; when it becomes odd it cannot decrease again, so no further operation can improve that normalized search path.
editorial: Only decreasing the current maximum can improve the range; when it becomes odd it cannot decrease again, so no further operation can improve that normalized search path.

tests.explanation: Normalize to two, two, six, four and halve six to three and four to two; range two through three has deviation one.
The best reachable values have maximum five and minimum three, giving deviation two.
